intermediate.name: San Giovanni in Monte
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (4) San Giovanni in Monte (135.1 km)
Red Bull KM Sprint | Arcugnano (169.6 km)

story: A nine-rider breakaway formed early, with Germani holding out the longest before being caught with 10 kilometres to go. Bardet and Vacek attacked, gaining a small lead, but were caught at the foot of the Monte Berico. Pedersen moved up in the peloton and launched the sprint with 200 metres remaining, holding off Van Aert to claim his fourth stage win of this Giro.
